items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: Mr. Abbe Goldberg used to book us in Shreveport

ctx.x: Do you have problems checking in the hotels or, you know?

Well, we did, now how we did, whenever we had to live in, you know, in places, we knew how to find the black part of town. And, well, this is what we looked for anyway, because we wanted to have fun. So we would always look for the black part of town, go check in, and then find where we were going to play. But most of our things was overnight. You didn't do a lot of... No, no. No, no. Now, you know, the early 50s was when I did a lot of, you know, we would go. Like we stayed in Nashville. We stayed in Washington,…
